scenarios.label: Pick or pass
scenarios.description: Seat 5 holds AH, 9C, AS, KD, QC, JD and must PICK or PASS. (This seat goes on to pick.)

scenarios.label: Call a partner
scenarios.description: Seat 5 picked and now holds AH, 9C, AS, KD, QC, JD, 9S, KS (8 cards after the blind). It must choose a partner card — the two-tower CALL scorer is the live head here.

scenarios.label: Bury two cards
scenarios.description: Seat 5 (the picker) holds AH, 9C, AS, KD, QC, JD, 9S, KS and must bury its first card — the pointer head scores every hand slot.

scenarios.label: Lead trick 3
scenarios.description: Seat 5 (the picker) leads trick 3 with 9C, JD, 9S, KS. The trick is empty; memory carries everything up to this lead.

scenarios.label: Follow late in the hand
scenarios.description: Trick 5: seat 5 (the picker) follows with 9S, KS after several cards hit the table. Trick tokens are live and the memory token carries every completed trick.
